title: A question to the owner stands on its own

checks.name: there is a question to judge

reasons: The question meets almost every criterion: it says what the task is (making credentials replaceable and removable in the panel, with the accounts page linking there), why it is asking (an unfinished overlapping change adds only a Substituir button), which option it recommends, and the default.
Each option says what will happen: one change to review and the other thread stops, the other change must be closed to avoid a conflict, or nothing starts yet.
Minor slip: 'merged' is version-control jargon used without explanation, and 'the general form' and 'work thread' are vague internal-sounding phrases.
It contains no internal ids or branch names, and at roughly 100 words it is under the 120-word limit.
